title: Kissed by the Fire Norwegian Deodeok-root Bake
description: A pescatarian-friendly, aerated Norwegian dish featuring deodeok-root, baked to perfection in a wood-fired oven.

ingredients.name: Deodeok-root
ingredients.notes: Peel and chop deodeok-root into 1-inch cubes

instructions: Place the deodeok-root cubes in a bowl and toss with butter, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Spread the deodeok-root mixture evenly on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the deodeok-root for 20 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Meanwhile, combine smoked salmon pieces, heavy cream, and chopped dill in a separate bowl.
Stir in grated Parmesan cheese and season with salt and black pepper.
Remove the deodeok-root from the oven and top with the salmon mixture.
Return to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional dill if desired.
